intro: Colombia exports oil, coal, coffee and flowers.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Colombia is a top producer of mild arabica coffee and the world's second-biggest exporter of cut flowers. Oil and coal are major exports, and emeralds from Colombia are the world's finest.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Visitors have boomed as safety improved.
